content: Spouses married 1990 under statutory community property, acquired apartment during marriage, separated 2003 (approved decree July 2003). Following non-final divorce judgment September 2014, wife sought dissolution and division, plus compensation for loss of enjoyment from presidential order date. Husband appeared citing economic difficulties and health issues, requesting property division into two units. Articles 191, 720, 1102 Italian Civil Code govern community dissolution, indivisible property division, and co-owner use rights. The issue concerned dissolution timing, division method for indivisible property, and compensation for exclusive occupation. Consensual separation approval (2003) constitutes dissolution cause but insufficient alone to terminate joint ownership—separate division required. Court-appointed expert deemed property indivisible: single entrance requires common area reducing usable space below minimum habitability requirements; division uneconomical requiring substantial costs for differentiated systems and risking devaluation. Usable floor space per share (35.60 sqm) below 38 sqm minimum for two persons per Building Regulations and Ministerial Decree 05/07/1975. Article 720 applies: absent assignment request with excess charge, auction sale required. Property valued €105,120.00. Wife assigned property (€233,000) plus parking (€8,000) with €980.37 adjustment obligation given her decade-long possession, disability, advanced age. Husband receives remaining properties plus €980.37 adjustment. Compensation due from division request date (September 2014), not presidential order date—co-owner's voluntary departure doesn't terminate Article 1102 use rights absent prior recovery initiatives. Wife owes €12,800 (32 months at €800/2) for property occupation plus €9,000 (30 months at €600/2) for unlawful appropriation of second property October 2011-March 2014. Costs fully compensated.
